decision_rule: Scope: the 54 stated rows outside mining that tools/sweep_company_level.py flags (one source page cited as stated by several plants for the same field, quote without the plant's city; OSHA rows removed), from sweep-other.txt (poles 5, ships 29, battery 20). Confirmed = the cited passage, directory entry or job requisition identifies this plant's site on the page itself: its street address; a named physical facility the page describes as a site (a shipyard, plant or facility section, a location heading, a numbered plant); or a city or state under the shared-city / campus rule (round-7 sweep wording; consultation 10: the company has no other production site there, or its other buildings there are within about 1 km doing the same production; checked against the ledger and the OSHA 2025 file). Job-board pages count as site-level when the cited requisition's location names the site. Corrected (retag inferred, value reworded as company-level where needed, plants_csv_value 'keep' unless the field must change) = the passage is about the company, a division or business unit named without a place (even one that has a single site, which another page must show), another site, or a city the rule does not tie to the plant. A row whose page carries both a site clause and a company clause is split: the site clause stays stated with its own fragments (corrected_value/corrected_quote) and the company clause goes to a new inferred row (split_add_row). A row whose cited listing has gone is corrected with the current page (stays stated if it still states the value). Unreachable only if the page cannot be read at all. 'Confirmed' in this file answers the site question only: two confirmed rows carry small value clauses their page does not show (Fincantieri Marinette's frigate-cancellation caveat, carried by the navytimes row; Eastern Nelson Street's '(steel)'), listed under leads, not counted.
error_rate_note: Targeted sweep of rows a script pre-flagged as likely company-level, not a random sample: 17/54 = 31.5% (17/53 = 32.1% of rows reached) is not comparable to sampled round rates and is not any vertical's general fact error rate. By vertical: poles 5 checked: 1 retagged inferred, 0 split (site clause kept stated), 0 corrected but still stated, 0 unreachable, 4 confirmed; ships 29 checked: 7 retagged inferred, 2 split (site clause kept stated), 1 corrected but still stated, 0 unreachable, 19 confirmed; battery 20 checked: 5 retagged inferred, 1 split (site clause kept stated), 0 corrected but still stated, 1 unreachable, 13 confirmed. Totals: 13 retagged inferred (4 tag-only, the value already saying company-level, other site or 'not this site': Hapco, Keel, LAD, Fairlead; 9 with the value reworded as company/division-level: JamesBuilt, Master Boat grant, DSC Reserve and Poplarville FAQ, Maysteel x4, Yancey Barnesville); 3 split, the site clause kept stated and the company clause moved to a new inferred row (NASSCO, Eastern Allanton, PSI Beloit); 1 stays stated with a refreshed quote because the cited listing closed (DSC Reserve welder_postings); 1 unreachable (Generac Eagle's Wayback page). 36 confirmed: the flag fired because the quote names a street address, yard, plant number, location heading, requisition location or AISC/BSI facility row instead of the city, or (Signet, Colonna, Accurity) a city or state where the company has one production site. Every quote on a reachable page was found, except DSC Reserve's closed listing. Nothing invented.
repeated_kinds: quote does not support value (16) - one pattern, the one this sweep targets: a company-, division- or other-site sentence tagged stated at one plant. 4 already said so in the value (tag-only), 9 needed the value reworded, 3 pages carried a site clause and a company clause in one row (split). Sub-patterns worth a sweep: (a) a division or unit named without a place (JamesBuilt's home-page drop-down; a single-site division still needs the page that places it); (b) a news item naming the company 'of <city>' where the plant is in a neighbouring place (Master Boat 'of Bayou La Bâtre', yard in Coden); (c) a division-level article about other plants cited at a third plant (Yancey: Cordele/Griffin article at Barnesville). Apply this file rather than sweep_company_level.py --apply, which would also retag the 36 confirmed site-level rows.
